production_sql.create: CREATE TABLE episode_progress (provider_id TEXT NOT NULL, video_id TEXT NOT NULL, episode_key TEXT NOT NULL, episode_name TEXT NOT NULL, position_ms INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(position_ms>0), updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(provider_id, video_id, episode_key))
production_sql.index: CREATE INDEX episode_progress_order ON episode_progress(updated_at DESC)
production_sql.trim: DELETE FROM episode_progress WHERE rowid IN (SELECT rowid FROM episode_progress ORDER BY updated_at DESC, provider_id ASC, video_id ASC, episode_key ASC LIMIT -1 OFFSET 200)

scope: Actual production SQL on an in-memory host SQLite database; v1 data preserved, isolated episode keys and 200-position trimming
